overview: A bold, editorial digital agency portfolio website inspired by locomotive.ca — featuring a hero, project portfolio with category filters, about/philosophy, services, blog, culture trips, merch store, and a dark footer. Built with black/white palette, serif typography, and smooth Motion.js animations.
features: Hero section with editorial serif typography and scroll animation
Featured work portfolio with category filter tabs (All/Branding/Digital/Experience/E-commerce/Content)
Project detail pages with case study content
Articles/Blog section with static post cards and detail pages
Culture section with static trip cards
Store section with static merch items
Smooth hover effects and viewport scroll animations via Motion.js
Responsive design from mobile to 1400px desktop
